Privacy policy

Last updated: 14 October 2026

This policy explains how the Commercial Opportunity Network website and prototype handle information.

The prototype

Everything you enter in the platform, including objectives, RFQs, offers and bookings, is stored only in your browser’s local storage. It is not sent to our servers. You can delete it at any time with “Reset demo data” or by clearing site data in your browser.

Early access requests

The early access form prepares a message that you send yourself by email. We receive nothing until you send that message. We then use your details only to reply and to organise the pilot.

Fonts

The site loads the Cairo typeface from Google Fonts, which means your browser may connect to Google’s servers.

The live platform

Before a live service launches, we will publish a full policy under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data, covering legal basis, retention periods, processors and your rights.

Contact

For privacy questions, write to:
